product.title: Fitzroy Island Day Tour from Cairns

description.text: In Cairns, this ferry day crosses to Fitzroy Island with published free time for snorkeling, beach hours, a glass-bottom upgrade, or rainforest trails. The public page is an island ferry ticket rather than a guided Outer Reef pontoon or a Kuranda Gold Class rail ride. The format suits visitors who want a continental-island day without a Daintree River cruise. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Cairns, and the itinerary stays on Cairns and Fitzroy Island that define this outing rather than a night wildlife walk at Lake Barrine.

highlights: Ferry from Cairns to Fitzroy Island
Fitzroy Island beach and rainforest trails
Optional snorkeling on the reef edge
Full island day with return ferry

start.description: Board the Fitzroy Island ferry from the published Cairns departure listed at booking.

end.description: Return to the Cairns meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
